card.title: Roots of the Moss
card.summary: Dome Seven's power is cut and the memory in its soil is being drained. The Moss Guardian follows the roots down to a level the city map says doesn't exist — where more than three thousand deleted names are buried.
card.quote: Roots remember every rain — and who dug them up.

hero-moss-01.title: Segment 1 · Roots
hero-moss-01.summary: Three days without power, and vines have crawled into the control room. The demolition crew is already at the gate.

m1-intro.speaker: Narration
m1-intro.text: Dome Seven has been dark for three days. Vines climbed through the vents into the control room and covered the last screen still glowing.

m1-hero.speaker: Moss Guardian
m1-hero.text: Every inch of soil here remembers me. Right now it's screaming.

m1-choice.prompt: Only two keys on the console still work.

m1-seed.speaker: Moss Guardian
m1-seed.text: The seeds are still here. Crushed under a collapsed rack, but alive.

m1-log.speaker: Skyvault
m1-log.text: Log: soil-memory extraction at 87%. The purpose field reads — "city memory backup".

m1-objective.title: Save the Greenhouse
m1-objective.description: Get back what matters before the roots die for good.
goals: Recover the seeds from bed three
Cut power to the memory extraction pump

m1-battle.title: Demolition Crew
m1-battle.brief: Skyvault's people aren't here to negotiate. They brought wrenches.

waves.label: Wave 1
waves.event: The sprinklers fail and the floor starts flooding

skills.name: Demolition Pulse
skills.description: A hydraulic arm slams down and shoves everyone back

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: The pump overloads; roots grind somewhere underground

skills.name: Root Bind
skills.description: Roots break the surface and wrap the target

m1-after.speaker: Narration
m1-after.text: When the pump stopped, the greenhouse went quiet enough to hear a seed crack open. The Moss Guardian buried it back in bed three and said nothing.

m1-reward.title: The Roots Remain
m1-reward.description: Skyvault struck Dome Seven from the demolition list. The reason field was left blank.

m1-end.title: End of Segment 1
m1-end.text: Some things don't need to be remembered. They grow back on their own.

hero-moss-02.title: Segment 2 · Soil Memory
hero-moss-02.summary: On the third night after the seed survived, roots split the floor and point underground — to a place the city map says doesn't exist.

m2-intro.speaker: Narration
m2-intro.text: The seed survived in bed three. On the third night, roots cracked the floor and drove straight down.

m2-hero.speaker: Moss Guardian
m2-hero.text: The roots are leading. They remember a road that no longer exists above ground.

m2-choice.prompt: The roots fork at the vent shaft.
options: Back the data up to the greenhouse first

m2-root.speaker: Moss Guardian
m2-root.text: There are names down there. A lot of names. Pressed into the soil, not yet rotted.

m2-battle.title: Beneath Level Zero
m2-battle.brief: The old underground district's sweepers still patrol on a seventeen-year-old order.

waves.label: Wave 1
waves.event: Platform tubes flicker on bad contacts

skills.name: Sweep Pulse
skills.description: A ring pulse that knocks targets back

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: Extraction pipes burst; memory leaks out like fog

skills.name: Root Bind
skills.description: Roots burst from the cracks and bind the target

m2-after.speaker: Narration
m2-after.text: When the sweepers stopped, roots dragged a rusted nameplate out of a wall seam. It listed the residents from seventeen years ago; the last line was the Moss Guardian's own serial number.

m2-reward.title: The Names Remain
m2-reward.description: The soil memory holds over three thousand names. They were never destroyed, only buried.

m2-end.title: End of Segment 2
m2-end.text: The Moss Guardian wiped the nameplate clean and put it back among the roots.

hero-moss-03.title: Segment 3 · Regrow
hero-moss-03.summary: Plant the names above ground, or let them stay buried?

m3-intro.speaker: Narration
m3-intro.text: By the time they reached the surface, dawn was breaking. A thin layer of green had already spread over Dome Seven's ruins.

m3-hero.speaker: Moss Guardian
m3-hero.text: These names need somewhere the sun can reach.

m3-choice.prompt: The public green's gate is open; Skyvault's patrol hasn't arrived.
options: Plant the memory in the public green

m3-open.speaker: Moss Guardian
m3-open.text: Plant it, and everyone sees. Including the people who wanted them gone.

m3-battle.title: The Gardener
m3-battle.brief: Skyvault didn't send a demolition crew this time. They sent a gardener.

waves.label: Wave 1
waves.event: Auto-irrigation kicks in and the ground turns slick

skills.name: Lockdown Pulse
skills.description: Area pulse that slows on hit

waves.label: Wave 2
waves.event: A neat cutting sound rises from under the turf

skills.name: Gardener's Shears
skills.description: Massive execute chance on low-HP targets

m3-after.speaker: Narration
m3-after.text: When the gardener fell, every root in the green shivered at once. The Moss Guardian knelt and pressed the first seed into the soil.

m3-reward.title: Regrown
m3-reward.description: The next day the public green had a patch of flowers nobody planted. The city report logged it as "natural growth".

m3-end.title: End of Segment 3
m3-end.text: Some names don't need a monument. They grow.
